name: project-vocabulary
description: Keep one ubiquitous language per project, written down. Maintains a CONCEPTS.md glossary at the repository root — behavioral definitions that stand on their own (no file paths or config values), one term per concept with retired synonyms as aliases, a Flagged Ambiguities tail — and applies it in conversation: fuzzy or conflicting term usage gets challenged at the moment it matters. Terms enter by accretion and by seeding an area's core nouns before sustained work. Terminology corrections land here; behavior and workflow corrections stay with lessons-learned. Lazy file creation; non-domain repos and trivial work stay silent.
